rationale: The plan matches the design precisely: DESeq2 Wald on raw counts with ~condition, control set as the explicit reference level, direction of the LFC stated, no batch or pairing term (correctly justified as unavailable and unneeded for a single-batch unpaired 6v6), plus a pre-specified leave-sample_01-out sensitivity cohort. QC is exemplary and dataset-specific: library sizes, detected genes, size factors, top-10-gene fraction, VST PCA and inter-sample correlation, with a keep/drop rule declared before the numbers are seen and a stated power cost of dropping 1 of 6. Normalization is median-of-ratios inside the model with an explicit ban on TPM/CPM input; BH at 0.05, independent filtering, apeglm shrinkage for reporting and ranking, and no post hoc fold-change filter before correction. Weaknesses: the low-count filter is only loosely specified ("a minimum count in at least the size of the smaller group" leaves the count threshold undefined, though the group-size logic is sound); the GSEA lacks an explicit set-size window (15–500) and an MSigDB version, and leaves the ranking metric as shrunken LFC "or" Wald statistic; and the report requirements name thresholds, gene counts and caveats but never require software/database version reporting.
